name: deployhermes
description: Run your DeployHermes workspace from your own AI assistant: skills and agents for triage, standups, missions, squads, schedules, knowledge and billing, over the DeployHermes MCP endpoint.

api_key.title: DeployHermes API key
api_key.description: Create a key in the DeployHermes app under Settings, API keys. Sent to https://deploy-hermes.com/mcp/v1 as a bearer token and stored in your system keychain.
